_meta.description: Wires genre-profiles.json values to the rules in rules.md. Each binding tells a rule which profile field to read and at what deviation to fire each severity tier. The engine resolves {genre} to the detected genre (phase2.genre mapped via genre_map) before reading.
_meta.resolution: Paths are relative to genre-profiles.json. {genre} is substituted at runtime. If the detected genre has no profile, fall back to genre_map.default and lower confidence.
_meta.severity_convention: Tiers are evaluated worst-first; the first matching tier wins. Absent source field => rule does not fire (never a failing grade for missing data).

genre_map._note: phase2.genre emits dnb/trance/house/techno/other. Map to profiles. Trance defaults to modern; a release-year or user hint can route to classic.
genre_map._classic_trance_override: Route to classic_trance only on explicit user/era hint; phase 2 cannot distinguish eras.

master_context._note: Which loudness world to judge against. The app sets this per analysis; rules that test loudness read the matching block.

A2_loudness_vs_target._note: Pick target by master_context. The sign of (value - target) tells the solver too-quiet vs too-loud.

A3_over_compression._genre_caveat: For techno, LRA below static_floor (3.0) may be inherent to a constant beat, NOT over-limiting. When {genre}==techno, require crest corroboration before firing and keep suspected:true.

A7_thin_low_end._note: Floor is relative to the genre's low-end emphasis. kick_dominance/low_mid_emphasis = high (techno) raise the floor vs trance. Derive a numeric floor from a measured corpus; until then this stays suspected.

A8_mud_buildup._note: Threshold is corpus-derived. Techno tolerates more low-mid (low_mid_emphasis=high); trance less. Scale the firing threshold by emphasis.

A9_harsh_upper_mid._note: Brightness is partly genre identity: rank 1 (modern trance) tolerates far more upper-mid/air than rank 3 (techno). Raise the firing ceiling for brighter ranks.

A10_dull_no_air._note: Inverse of A9: a trance track (air_emphasis very_high) should be flagged dull at a HIGHER air floor than techno (air_emphasis moderate).

A12_over_widened._note: Ceiling scales with width_character: 'widest'/'wide' (trance) tolerate more than 'narrow_centered' (techno). An over-width that's normal for trance is a real flag for techno.

A15_missing_section._genre_caveat: Techno is structure_type 'linear_hypnotic' — do NOT flag a missing euphoric drop/breakdown. required_sections for techno omits buildup/drop by design.

bpm_genre_match._note: Soft mismatch warning only — subgenres legitimately span wide (e.g. hard techno 140–150, progressive trance 128–134). Never an error.

composite_bindings._note: Tier C composites read the same genre fields. Listed here so the de-suspecting thresholds stay genre-aware.

C1_loudness_war._note: C1's hardcoded crest<6/LRA<4 should defer to genre values: a techno crest of 5 is fine, so C1 must use the techno warn_below (4.0), not the generic 6. Prevents false loudness-war flags on genres that are dense by design.

C7_no_drop_payoff._note: Never fires for techno (linear_hypnotic has no drop to pay off).
